nodes.name: how-it-works.md
nodes.summary: Architecture overview: Plugin Manager as an OxiGuitar plugin using interface 1.15. Components: manager (state machine), files (entry display), network (import analysis), releases (GitHub API), install (file operations), ui (Slint views). Thread model: UI on OxiGuitar's thread, network/file work on plugin's threads.

nodes.name: requirements.md
nodes.summary: System requirements: OxiGuitar with plugin interface 1.15+, Rust toolchain for building, network access for update checking (github.com), platform support (Linux, Windows, macOS).
